name: Input
states: focus (outline text, label text; no outer ring)
r11: Label style 5b: legend in the border (notched outline). Applies to text, select, textarea in sheets, dialogs and Board settings.

label.fieldset: position:absolute; inset:-6px 0 0 0; margin:0; padding:0 8px; border:2px solid var(--field-outline); border-radius:var(--radius-field); pointer-events:none; min-width:0
label.legend: padding:0 6px; font:600 12.5px/14px var(--font-ui); visibility:hidden; white-space:nowrap  (creates the gap in the border on any background)
label.visibleLabel: position:absolute; left:10px; top:-6px; padding:0 6px; font:600 12.5px/14px var(--font-ui); color:var(--color-text-muted)
label.wrapper: position:relative; margin-top:6px (room for the label above the border)
label.control: border:0; background:transparent; height:52px; padding:13px 16px 15px; font:500 15.5px/20px var(--font-ui)  (13/15 = 1px optical lift, measured for Figtree; with Hanken Grotesk too)
label.select: appearance:none; padding-right:44px; chevron 18px at right:16px, vertically centred
label.withButton: row = flex, align-items:center, gap 10px; button 44px round (inverse). Label is inside the border, so the button centres on the field.

alternatives.5a: Label above, 13/16 600, 8px gap, indented 16px (aligned with the field text). Field filled surface-muted; focus = 2px text outline + 4px focus ring.
alternatives.5c: Pebble tab label joined to a filled field (tab radius 14px 12px 0 0, field radius 0 16px 19px 17px); focus tints tab + field butter 26%, error danger 12%.

name: RecipeSection
placement: Dish detail (phone + desktop panel): image, chips, title, Creator, Caption, action row, share row, RecipeSection, Verlauf, Verschieben nach…, Archivieren. Everything above it is short and fixed-height, so the actions never move and the Recipe always starts in the same place.
variants: full: header + Zutaten list + Schritte list
Zutaten only / Schritte only (the missing list renders nothing, no heading)
long: taller than 2 viewports → adds RecipeSwitch
with source line: "Rezept von <host>" under the lists, links to recipeSourceUrl; absent when the Recipe came from the Source itself
with unsent mark: "Noch nicht gesendet" on the header (same mark as the Dish card)
states: read, may edit: header shows "Bearbeiten" (Button secondary, 38px, pencil)
no Recipe, may edit: only "Rezept hinzufügen" (Button dashed, 52px), no header
no Recipe, may not edit: renders nothing (no gap)
arriving: see Interaction "A found Recipe arrives"
motion: header + lists: static in read mode
arriving: Interaction "A found Recipe arrives" · settle + stagger

name: RecipeList

steps: 34px pebble (surface-muted, radius.blob) with the number in type.recipe-num + text, rows 13/14px padding, hairline between
states: long (60 / 40 lines): never folds, Steps never clamp

name: RecipeLine
note: One plain line of text. No amounts, units, checkboxes, timers or images.
variants: edit: grip (36×52 button) · step number (Petrona 17, text-muted) · auto-growing textarea (Figtree 500 17/24) · remove (42×52, ×)
states: edit focus (surface fill + inset 2px text outline, radius.field, caret)
edit near limit (counter "n von 200|1000" under the line, text-muted, from 180 / 900)
edit at limit (typing stops, counter text colour, helper sentence; never danger colour)
edit lifted (drag) / picked (keyboard: 2px text outline, grip focus ring, move menu)
motion: remove: x +44 + fade 260 ease-in, collapse · settle
lift: 1.03×, −1.5°, shadow.lift · lift (same as Columns in Board Settings)
a11y: accessibility actions "Nach oben" / "Nach unten"; desktop Alt+↑/↓
live region (polite): "{line}, jetzt an Stelle {n} von {total}."

name: RecipeEditor
variants: phone: tall BottomSheet (top 50px), header Abbrechen / "Rezept" / Speichern, keyboard pushes the sheet body
desktop panel (440–480px): the panel content becomes the editor (no dialog)
states: dirty (Abbrechen, swipe down, Esc, Back ask with Dialog "Änderungen verwerfen?")
list full: add button replaced by note "60 Zutaten, mehr passen nicht in ein Rezept." with Topfbert happy 34px on color.search-tint
saving offline: closes, RecipeSection shows unsent mark
rules: Enter ends the line and inserts a new focused line below; Enter on an empty last line closes the keyboard
Backspace on an empty line removes it, caret to end of the line above
paste with line breaks: one line per non-empty line at the caret; strip leading "•", "-", "*", "1.", "1)"; fill up to the limit, toast tells how many did not fit
save: trim lines, drop empty ones; both lists empty = no Recipe
Recipe saves as one document (Zutaten + Schritte together)
motion: open/close: Interaction "Sheet open / close" (phone); desktop: content crossfade fade 240 + rise 14px settle

name: RecipeSwitch

states: hidden (Recipe shorter than 2 viewports, or Recipe not on screen)

variants: action: "Rezept finden" (Button secondary, magnifier) + "Rezept hinzufügen" (Button dashed); equal size, flex-wrap (stack on phone, row ≥ 400px)

none: "Kein Rezept gefunden" + "In der Caption und auf der verlinkten Seite stand keins." + Rezept hinzufügen (editors)
failed: Topfbert oops still 46px + "Die Suche hat gerade nicht geklappt." + "Noch mal suchen" (Finder users) + Rezept hinzufügen
